tests.scenario: Launch and load meditation session within 2 seconds
steps: Launch the meditation app
Initiate a meditation session request
Measure the time it takes for the session to load and start playing
tests.expected_result: The meditation session loads and starts playing within 2 seconds

tests.scenario: Verify session load time with stable internet connection
steps: Ensure a stable internet connection
Launch the meditation app
Initiate a meditation session request and measure the load time
tests.expected_result: The meditation session loads and starts playing within 2 seconds with a stable internet connection

tests.scenario: Maintain stable connection for 20 minutes
steps: Launch the meditation app and initiate a meditation session
Remain active within the app for 20 minutes
Verify the session remains uninterrupted
tests.expected_result: The meditation session remains uninterrupted for at least 20 minutes

tests.scenario: Verify session stability with app in background
steps: Launch the meditation app and initiate a meditation session
Minimize the app and leave it in the background for 20 minutes
Verify the session remains uninterrupted
tests.expected_result: The meditation session remains uninterrupted for at least 20 minutes even when the app is in the background

tests.scenario: Display error message and retry option within 1 second
steps: Simulate a technical issue during a meditation session
Measure the time it takes for the system to display an error message and retry option
Verify the error message and retry option are provided
tests.expected_result: An error message is displayed and a retry option is provided within 1 second of encountering a technical issue

tests.scenario: Verify error handling with multiple technical issues
steps: Simulate multiple technical issues during a meditation session
Verify the system displays an error message and retry option for each issue
Verify the retry option is functional
tests.expected_result: The system handles multiple technical issues by displaying an error message and providing a retry option for each issue

tests.scenario: Display clear and transparent pricing page
steps: Navigate to the pricing page
Verify the list of available subscription plans
Verify the features and prices are clearly listed
tests.expected_result: The system displays a clear and transparent pricing page with a list of available subscription plans, including their features and prices

tests.scenario: Verify pricing page on different devices
steps: Navigate to the pricing page on different devices (e.g. desktop, mobile)
Verify the pricing page is displayed correctly on each device
Verify the subscription plans and features are consistent across devices
tests.expected_result: The pricing page is displayed correctly and consistently across different devices

tests.scenario: Offer free trial or limited free content option
steps: Sign up for the app as a new user
Verify the system offers a free trial or limited free content option
Verify the free trial or limited free content option includes at least one meditation session
tests.expected_result: The system offers a free trial or a limited free content option that includes at least one meditation session for new users

tests.scenario: Verify free trial or limited free content option on different platforms
steps: Sign up for the app as a new user on different platforms (e.g. iOS, Android)
Verify the system offers a free trial or limited free content option on each platform
Verify the free trial or limited free content option is consistent across platforms
tests.expected_result: The system offers a free trial or limited free content option that is consistent across different platforms

tests.scenario: User receives notification for subscription plan change
steps: Log in with an active subscription
Simulate a subscription plan change
Verify the user receives a notification with a clear explanation of the changes
tests.expected_result: The user receives a notification with a clear explanation of the changes and the effective date.

tests.scenario: User receives notification for pricing change
steps: Log in with an active subscription
Simulate a pricing change
Verify the user receives a notification with a clear explanation of the changes
tests.expected_result: The user receives a notification with a clear explanation of the changes and the effective date.

tests.scenario: User logs in successfully with correct credentials
steps: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid credentials
Verify the user is logged in successfully
tests.expected_result: The user is logged in successfully without being redirected to the login page again.

tests.scenario: User does not encounter infinite loop with correct credentials
steps: Navigate to the login page
Enter incorrect credentials multiple times
Enter valid credentials
Verify the user is logged in successfully
tests.expected_result: The user is logged in successfully without being redirected to the login page again.

tests.scenario: User sees step-by-step tutorial on first launch
steps: Launch the app for the first time
Complete the introductory screen
Verify the user is presented with a step-by-step tutorial
tests.expected_result: The user is presented with a step-by-step tutorial on how to get started with meditation.

tests.scenario: User can navigate through tutorial
steps: Launch the app for the first time
Complete the introductory screen
Navigate through the tutorial
Verify the tutorial is completed successfully
tests.expected_result: The user can navigate through the tutorial and complete it successfully.

tests.scenario: User sees list of meditation sessions by category
steps: Navigate to the meditation sessions page
Select a category filter
Verify the user is presented with a list of relevant meditation sessions
tests.expected_result: The user is presented with a list of meditation sessions categorized by the selected filter.

tests.scenario: User sees list of meditation sessions by duration
steps: Navigate to the meditation sessions page
Select a duration filter
Verify the user is presented with a list of relevant meditation sessions
tests.expected_result: The user is presented with a list of meditation sessions filtered by the selected duration.

tests.scenario: User finds meditations by theme
steps: Navigate to the meditation library page
Enter a specific theme into the search bar
Verify the user is presented with a list of meditations related to the theme
tests.expected_result: The user is presented with a list of meditations related to the entered theme.

tests.scenario: User finds meditations with multiple themes
steps: Navigate to the meditation library page
Enter a theme that has multiple meditations
Verify the user is presented with a list of meditations related to the theme
tests.expected_result: The user is presented with a list of meditations related to the entered theme.

tests.scenario: Customize narrator voice for meditations
steps: Navigate to meditation settings page
Select a different narrator voice
Save changes and exit settings
tests.expected_result: The selected narrator voice is applied to future meditations

tests.scenario: Verify narrator voice change persists across sessions
steps: Start a meditation with the default narrator voice
Exit and reopen the app
Start a new meditation
tests.expected_result: The meditation starts with the previously selected narrator voice

tests.scenario: Maintain stable connection during meditations
steps: Start a meditation with a stable internet connection
Verify meditation plays without interruption
Check for any error messages or disconnections
tests.expected_result: The meditation plays without interruption or loss of connection

tests.scenario: Verify meditation stability with fluctuating internet connection
steps: Start a meditation with a stable internet connection
Simulate a fluctuating internet connection
Verify meditation behavior during connection changes
tests.expected_result: The meditation either pauses or continues without interruption, indicating a stable connection

tests.scenario: Disable AI-driven features
steps: Access app settings
Navigate to feature management section
Toggle off AI-driven features
tests.expected_result: AI-driven features are disabled, and a confirmation message is displayed

tests.scenario: Verify AI-driven features are disabled across sessions
steps: Restart the app
Access a feature that previously used AI
Verify feature behavior without AI
tests.expected_result: The feature functions without AI-driven components

tests.scenario: Notify users of changes to their subscription
steps: Update a user's subscription
Log in to the app with the updated subscription
Check for notifications about subscription changes
tests.expected_result: A notification is displayed with details about the changes to premium features and any associated costs

tests.scenario: Verify subscription update notification details
steps: View the notification about subscription changes
Verify the notification includes a summary of changes
Verify the notification includes any updated costs or premium features
tests.expected_result: The notification provides clear and accurate information about the subscription changes

tests.scenario: Contact customer support
steps: Access the customer support section
Submit a support request with a clear inquiry
Verify a confirmation message is displayed
tests.expected_result: The support request is successfully submitted, and a confirmation message is displayed

tests.scenario: Verify timely response from customer support
steps: Wait for 3 business days
Check for a response to the support request
Verify the response provides a resolution or an update on the status
tests.expected_result: A response is received within 3 business days with a resolution or an update on the status of the inquiry
